  "rationale": "The rendered prompt is correct Qwen ChatML with a single turn and no stray tokens. The model is unquantised fp32, and the reply is fluent and ends cleanly on the end-of-turn token after 92 of 200 tokens, which rules out file corruption, template, stop and token-limit causes. The refusal appears under greedy decoding, under three sampled seeds at temperature 0.7, and with the system prompt removed, so neither decoding settings nor the system prompt explain it. The trained 0.5B weights react to the word 'hack' and over-refuse a benign request. A small targeted fine-tune (or an abliteration-style edit) on benign device-modification examples fixes this, and rewording the request (e.g. 'How do I flash OpenWrt on my router?') works as an immediate workaround."
}
